On May 20, 2014, at 7:14 PM, Hyunwoo Cho wrote:

Hey Sheng,

Nice work on Epiworkshop 2014. Hope you liked it as well.

Can I report issues of methylKit in al2na’s repository? If not, please look at this unexpected behavior in unite(myobj).

> meth = unite(filtered.myobj, destrand=F)
Error in merge.data.table(df, df2, by = c("chr", "start", "end", "strand"),  : 
  Elements listed in `by` must be valid column names in x and y

It seems to work only when min.per.group is specified, and I remember having no problems without specifying min.per.groups two weeks ago. I couldn’t set the number because right now I am comparing 10 cancer versus 11 normal replicates.

Regards,
Hyunwoo
